evidence: ssh-hardened-without-password-or-root-login: node_base_desktop.pp:17-18 default password_authentication and ssh_allow_root_login to false, passed to ssh_secure (43-46), which maps false to 'no' for PasswordAuthentication/PermitRootLogin (ssh_secure.pp:43-52); the fixture leaves both at default, so sshd -T expecting 'passwordauthentication no' and 'permitrootlogin no' tests exactly those lines

the-apt-helpers-are-in-desktop-mode: filesystem_apt.pp:72-81 declare, when server_mode is false (node_base_desktop.pp:65-68 passes false), the link apt-update-surface-desktop.sh -> ${localdir}/bin/apt-update-surface.sh; with apt_surface_list empty, filesystem_apt.pp:43-57 select the desktop list (firefox, not nginx-core/postfix), so the readlink and list membership expectations follow from the baseline

logs-forwarded-to-the-log-target: node_base_desktop.pp:21-24 make log_target required and log_port default 6514; rsyslog_client renders forward_simple.conf.epp into /etc/rsyslog.d/40-forward.conf whose rule is '*.*  @@<target>:<port>'; with the fixture target puppet8master.example.com the expected '*.* @@puppet8master.example.com:6514' (whitespace normalised) is what the code produces

purpose covered: The outcomes table covers every part of the baseline manifest (lines 39-108): SSH hardening and unattended-upgrades removal, firewall_secure's IPv4 policy, filesystem_base_desktop dirs, filesystem_apt desktop mode, the IPv6 drop policy, the 02:00 relevant-updates cron, the rsyslog forward rule, the GNOME dconf lock policy (read back through dconf with a mismatch control on the profile name), the puppet service enabled/active, and, after the stand-in lift, the real agent daemon restarted making its own catalog run with no events besides Exec[apt_update] (mutating check: declares the restart and the /run timestamp file, effect reads the journal and /proc, not the action's output).
